bullets.text: picked the guitar back up after a week off. fingers remembered more than they should have, which felt like cheating and a gift.
duck reached enko-ji under flat grey light. made nothing today, just carried a line about broken habits the rest of the way. 🌀
the specific okay of starting again on a thing you'd quietly given up on.
overcast all day. the kind of sky that makes the whole town look like a photo no one bothered to develop.
a dropped habit doesn't leave. it waits in the next room, mildly disappointed, ready.
